stories.title: Build WIM Format Compliance Validator Against Buku Panduan WIM Edisi 2020 Standards
stories.description: Create Python validation tool that enforces Buku Panduan WIM Edisi 2020 compliance across all WIM markdown files: validates filename patterns (NOSS-Code-CU/DocCode format), required section structure (Tujuan/Objectives, Kandungan/Content, Penilaian/Assessment), table layouts, and bilingual term density. Generates JSON compliance report with violations grouped by category and file-level compliance scores.
acceptanceCriteria: Tool _agents/wim_format_validator.py implements: (1) filename regex validation matching NOSS-Code-CU/DocCode(seq/total).md pattern, (2) heading structure check for mandatory sections (## Tujuan, ## Kandungan, ## Penilaian, ## Nota Kritis), (3) bilingual term density validation (≥5 EN/BM pairs per 500 words)

Tool generates JSON output (_agents/wim_compliance_report.json) with fields: file_path, compliance_score (0-100), violation_count, violations (array of {type, location, suggestion}). Returns exit code 1 if any file <95% compliant or <5 BEV/Aesthetic/IT directories scanned

Recursively scans bev-diagnostic-rectification/, aesthetic-services/, it-computer-system/ and produces summary: total_files_scanned, compliant_files, at_risk_files (60-94%), non_compliant_files (<60%), with categorized violation counts by type (file_naming, missing_section, table_format, bilingual_terms)
technicalNotes: Files to create: _agents/wim_format_validator.py (main validator logic, ~180 lines) and _agents/wim_format_rules.json (rule definitions per Panduan)

Validation logic: (1) filename: regex ^[A-Z0-9]+-[A-Z0-9]+:[0-9]{4}-C\d{2}/[A-Z]{2}\(\d+/\d+\)\.md$; (2) headings: search for '## Tujuan', '## Kandungan', '## Penilaian' in order; (3) bilingual: grep -oE '(EN:|BM:|English:|Melayu:)' and count pairs

Test command: python _agents/wim_format_validator.py --path bev-diagnostic-rectification/ --output report.json --verbose 2>&1 | head -20 (should list violations by file). Validation: python _agents/wim_format_validator.py --check-all; echo $? (should return 0 if all >95% compliant)

stories.title: Create Aesthetic C03 Knowledge Assessment with Manual Technique Competency Questions
stories.description: Build knowledge assessment for C03 (Manual Body Massage) with 10 questions covering anatomy landmarks, massage technique selection logic, contraindication identification, and client safety. Include 3 scenario-based questions where learners analyze client conditions and recommend appropriate massage modalities with supporting justification and safety considerations.
acceptanceCriteria: File aesthetic-services/c03-manual-body-massage/KA.md created with 10 distinct questions: 4 anatomy identification (name muscles/nerves from descriptions), 3 scenario-based technique selection (client presents with condition→choose technique & justify), 2 contraindication identification, 1 safety procedure question. Each question includes answer scheme with rubric points (basic/intermediate/advanced confidence levels)

All 10 questions include bilingual key terms cross-referenced to _reference/wim-bilingual-glossary.md (e.g., 'erector spinae | otot penunjang tulang belakang', 'piriformis | otot pirifomis'). Scenario questions include 2-3 point rubric: knows correct technique, understands contraindications, justifies decision safely

All content references and validates against NOSS S960-002-3:2020 C03 CoCU knowledge requirements (muscle anatomy, technique selection criteria); anatomy references match aesthetic-services/c03-manual-body-massage/KP-02.md Anatomy & Physiology section with specific page/figure references
technicalNotes: File to create: aesthetic-services/c03-manual-body-massage/KA.md with structure [Q1-Q10] sections containing {Question | Scenario Context (if applicable) | Expected Answer | Rubric Points | Bilingual Terms | CoCU Reference Code}
Validate against NOSS S960-002-3:2020 C03 CoCU assessment criteria; cross-check anatomy terms against KP-02.md section headings

Test command: grep -c '^## Q' aesthetic-services/c03-manual-body-massage/KA.md (expected: 10); grep -c 'Scenario\|case study' aesthetic-services/c03-manual-body-massage/KA.md (expected: ≥3); grep -oE 'EN:|BM:' aesthetic-services/c03-manual-body-massage/KA.md | wc -l (expected: ≥30 total terms)
